text:
Olivia Park: Heads up — seeing a big spike in SLO notify hits for tenant=shoply after the rollout :rotating_light:
Samir Patel: Confirmed. Alerts doubled in the last 10m, looks like a repeat flap pattern
Ben Cho: Is this storming or real errors? any tracer/stack info?
Olivia Park: Telemetry quick check: `slo.alerts.count{tenant:shoply}` 2.4x baseline. Latency regressions align with rollout window
Marie Gonzalez: Could be duplicate fanout — new routing policy sends to primary+fallback during canary, maybe we didn't dedupe before notify
Eng Console Bot: Deploy 2026-03-21 by @deploy-bot: canary rollout 17% -> 42%
Samir Patel: If routing duplicates, we should dedupe pre-fanout. Short-term mitigation: increase eval window or per-tenant rate-limit
Ben Cho: I can apply emergency rate-limit. Idea: `notify.rate_limit{tenant=shoply}=10/min` and bump threshold window to 60s
Olivia Park: Ops would also love an 'throttle notifications' toggle on the SLO card in console for quick mitigation
Marie Gonzalez: Longer term: console should display a "noise score" and suggest actions (increase window, backoff, lower fanout). I added a Figma mock: https://figma.com/file/abc123/noise-panel
Samir Patel: Agreed. Also add a routing-trace to telemetry so we can see duplicate paths per request id
Ben Cho: Applying patch now: ```PATCH /api/configs/notify
{"tenant":"shoply","rate_limit":"10/min","window":"60s"}``` Will monitor for 10m and rollback if no improvement
DeployBot: Rolling config change cfg-9876 to prod (staged)
Olivia Park: :thumbsup: Thanks Ben. If this calms down we'll schedule a handoff with console UX + platform next Wed 11:00 for a permanent flow
Samir Patel: Please post the alert histogram after 10m so we can verify the noise delta
Ben Cho: Will do — posting results in this thread in ~12m
Marie Gonzalez: Also documenting the proposed console affordances in the SLO card RFC repo after we confirm
Olivia Park: Great, thanks team. Keep short updates here so oncall can follow
